id.description: The unique ID of this volume.

status.description: The current status of this volume.

size.description: The size of this volume in GB.

region.description: The region where this volume is located.

linode_id.description: The ID of the Linode this volume is attached to, or null.

linode_label.description: The label of the Linode this volume is attached to.

filesystem_path.description: The filesystem path for this volume on the attached Linode.

updated.description: When this volume was last updated.
